rows.text: An idea or question becomes a Pipeline row with a permanent numeric ID

cards.title: Supervisor
cards.text: horology-supervisor reads the item and decision feedback, checks the document graph, and chooses agents and a platform from the Agent Register

cards.title: Research
cards.text: horology-research: evidence, options and a recommendation

cards.title: Technical assessment
cards.text: horology-technical-assessment: alternatives, effort, cost and uncertainty

cards.title: Drive deliverable and Document Index
cards.text: Saved to the domain folder from the Location Directory; Graph Inclusion decides whether it enters the graph

rows.text: Recorded in the Decision Register and reviewed in ClickUp

cards.title: Rework
cards.text: Back to Stage 1 with the decision's instructions

cards.title: Approve
cards.text: A defined scope moves to Stage 3

rows.text: The approved proposal becomes a detailed deliverable, then review. For code work, a planning note, not automatic implementation.
